title: Man Stranded on Island Rescued by Coast Guard
description: A Coast Guard C-130 Hercules aircrew spots a man who was stranded for approximately six days after his dinghy went adrift and landed him on an island in Cay Sal Bank, Bahamas, Dec. 15, 2014. The man was subsequently rescued by the Coast Guard Cutter Kathleen Moore and taken back to Key West with no major injuries. Video by Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater.
